improvement_need:axm:need:align-asset-fa.desired_outcome: Manifest, contract, and registry expose one deliberate version relationship or an explicit compatibility mapping.
improvement_need:axm:need:align-asset-fa.observed_problem: Asset Fabric manifest version v0.9 conflicts with contract version v0.12.
improvement_need:axm:need:align-asset-fa.verification_method: Validate that manifest and contract versions match or that a machine-readable compatibility field explains the difference.

improvement_need:axm:need:align-game-hub.desired_outcome: Game Hub publishes one unambiguous service contract version and Game Forge resolves it explicitly.
improvement_need:axm:need:align-game-hub.observed_problem: Game Hub manifest version v0.4 conflicts with contract version v0.2 while Game Forge consumes the service.
improvement_need:axm:need:align-game-hub.verification_method: Run contract resolution tests from Game Forge against the corrected Game Hub version declaration.

improvement_need:axm:need:build-capabili.desired_outcome: High-reach capabilities move through visible DECLARED, TESTED, and REPRODUCED evidence stages without blanket promotion.
improvement_need:axm:need:build-capabili.observed_problem: The generated spine contains 1,769 capability declarations, while the repository explicitly states that declarations and self-test presence are not runtime proof.
improvement_need:axm:need:build-capabili.verification_method: Select a small high-reach capability set, retain test inputs and outputs, reproduce results independently, and update only those proof states.

improvement_need:axm:need:clarify-offlin.desired_outcome: The public source route and separately packaged offline candidate route are clearly distinguished and independently tested.
improvement_need:axm:need:clarify-offlin.observed_problem: Offline first launch is not claimed for the public source path, while an offline Windows candidate capability exists separately.
improvement_need:axm:need:clarify-offlin.verification_method: Test both routes separately and ensure documentation never transfers proof from the offline candidate to the source-bootstrap route.

improvement_need:axm:need:clarify-snapsh.desired_outcome: Snapshot version, package version, and published release version are separately named and machine-readable.
improvement_need:axm:need:clarify-snapsh.observed_problem: The latest commit is labeled an AXM Workshop v0.5.0 experimental public snapshot while public status documents still name v0.3.0-experimental as the current release.
improvement_need:axm:need:clarify-snapsh.verification_method: Confirm each version field has one meaning and generate all public labels from the same version metadata.

improvement_need:axm:need:import-real-mo.desired_outcome: Dry-run ingest the real Module 1 and Module 2 packages, preserve their identities and evidence, resolve compatible references, surface conflicts, and replace placeholders only after validation without granting execution or CANON authority.
improvement_need:axm:need:import-real-mo.observed_problem: Module 3 currently links to Module 1 and Module 2 through explicit placeholder interoperability references rather than ingested implementation artifacts and current handoff records.
improvement_need:axm:need:import-real-mo.verification_method: Run the three-module intake preflight against the actual packages; require unique identities, compatible contract versions, resolvable capability/interface references, preserved evidence, zero silent overwrite, and a deterministic dry-run merge plan before any canonical import.

improvement_need:axm:need:prove-clean-ma.desired_outcome: Platform-specific launch evidence is captured or the unsupported boundary remains explicit.
improvement_need:axm:need:prove-clean-ma.observed_problem: A clean first launch on macOS and Linux is not independently proven.
improvement_need:axm:need:prove-clean-ma.verification_method: Execute the pinned snapshot on clean target systems and retain exact environment, commands, health results, and failures.

improvement_need:axm:need:refresh-genera.desired_outcome: Human-facing discovery counts are generated from or checked against the current registry digest.
improvement_need:axm:need:refresh-genera.observed_problem: The pinned README reports 177 modules and 1,183 declared capabilities, while the generated registry at the same commit reports 210 modules and 1,769 declared capabilities.
improvement_need:axm:need:refresh-genera.verification_method: Regenerate the human-facing count block from the pinned registry and assert exact equality in CI.

improvement_need:axm:need:reuse-existing.desired_outcome: Module 3 remains the system graph, evolution ledger, and outcome intelligence layer while reusing bounded sibling providers through adapters.
improvement_need:axm:need:reuse-existing.observed_problem: Several existing modules already provide observation, research, evidence, scheduling, review, diagnostics, recovery, and packaging functions that Module 3 could accidentally duplicate.
improvement_need:axm:need:reuse-existing.verification_method: Demonstrate one closed loop where each sibling performs only its declared role and Module 3 retains decision traceability without execution authority.

improvement_need:axm:need:run-independen.desired_outcome: A first-time user completes one bounded task while confusion, errors, assistance, and completion evidence are retained.
improvement_need:axm:need:run-independen.observed_problem: Independent first-time-human comprehension has not been run.
improvement_need:axm:need:run-independen.verification_method: Run an independent beginner trial with a fixed task and preserve a digest-bound result without coaching away the friction.
